items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: Yeah. Yeah. And, uh, as you kind of recall again, John Guto.

ctx.x: I heard him on banjo and trombone and all.

Yeah. Yeah. And, uh, as you kind of recall again, John Guto. Oh, this little fellow Kimball, he started with guitar. Oh yeah. Mm-hmm. Little left hand Kimball. Yep. He started with guitar. But all, all the guitars, I'd rather hear, uh, John San Siro play guitar.
They must contact the, Jeanette Kimball too. Uh huh. I've never talked to her.
